assets.name: Giấy kem xé viền
assets.prompt: Create ONE square 1:1 decorative PAPER BACKGROUND to surround a circular teacher portrait on an English tutor website. Premium colored pencil illustration with tactile paper grain and hand-drawn imperfect lines. Warm ivory scrapbook wrapping paper, layered torn paper edges and two small beige masking-tape corners. Delicate colored pencil doodles confined to outer corners: a tiny pencil, open notebook, small coral stars and one simple leafy sprig. Cream, pale honey, teal accents. Friendly elegant hand-crafted learning journal feel. Keep the central 70 percent as pale blank paper, no shapes crossing the center, the portrait will be overlaid separately. Decorative details small and near edges so the face remains the focus. Fully opaque background, all four edges inside frame with a little breathing room. NO person, no face, no photographic content, no lettering, no numbers, no words, no text, no logo, no watermark. A finished flat 2D paper collage backdrop, no tabletop perspective or UI mockup.
assets.review: Opened final WebP directly; no text or visible drawing defects. Original portrait overlaid in HTML only. Preview viewed after checking circular proportions.
